finding.text: The task folder has no requirements.md and session.jsonl has no outcome line (past-work.md says "no outcome logged"), so a fresh agent cannot tell what was asked or what the plan was. Add requirements.md (the owner's ask for the session page) and log the landed outcome.

No module readme or doc is touched, though the Overview head, Timeline kinds and filters changed. public/framework/ai/AISession/readme.md should mention the new Timeline kinds (chat, plumbing, "Other, unrecognized lines"), the default-hidden set (log, tag, plumbing), and the Prompt/Question rows that link to ?tab=timeline.

The Prompt/Question chat records are still counted and drawn as tasks in "Other work". The session.jsonl note said they would be dropped from Overview/Tasks, but the diff only retitles them and links them to the Timeline (SessionOutline.js:~106, SessionOutlineView.js:~90). The 201-chat-rows-as-tasks problem is left open and only recorded in a comment, with no task filed (law 5/10).

SessionOutlineView.js:~58 puts a 4-line docblock about removed behaviour ("used to sit here...") on head(). It narrates history and the current task, which the comment rules forbid. Cut it to one line. The same applies to the long history comments in SessionOverview.css and SessionTimelineRows.js.

The no-uuid branch in AISessionDetail.js:~345 prints developer wording to the owner: "GET /ai-logs/<id>/session needs a uuid it doesn't have". Replace it with plain words, e.g. "Voice sessions have no Claude Code class numbers."

The Timeline "hidden by Filters ▾" count (SessionTimeline.js:~122) assumes the Filters control carries that label. Confirm it from the shot shots/framework-ai-AISession-3440.png. No other widths were taken, and none are needed for this change.

The Cost/Newest toggle (SessionOutlineView.js:~70) is now a pill pair, but SessionOutlineView's own docblock and any readme text still describe the old single button. The old title "Ranked by cost · newest first" is gone from the code, which is fine.

SessionTimeline.test.mjs covers the new kinds and passes by reading. There is no test for the Prompt/Question title change in SessionOutline.js (constructor.name based), and that rule would break silently on a minified or renamed class.
